title: Stan Meyer collection group killed
place_text: Michigan; United Kingdom; Orange County, California

tellings.quote: Stan Meyer guys, you know who those guys who got the Stan Meyer collection and that Toroid, all of them but one were killed.

plain: The men who got hold of the inventions of Stan Meyer, an inventor said to have built devices that ran on unusual energy, including a ring-shaped "toroid" device, were all killed except one, according to the UFO campaigner Steven Greer. Greer tells Michels this as something he was told, linking it to an unnamed British lord and to places in Michigan, the United Kingdom and Orange County, California. If true, it would mean people are being killed to keep such technology hidden.
